visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Tasks added later do not respond
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Items that the script adds later do not react to clicks, only the ones that were in the page at the start do. Each item gets its own listener when it is first found.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: • First

solution.code: • First
solution.explanation: Listeners attached to the items at the start only exist for those items. One listener on the list gets clicks from items added later too, because the click bubbles up to the list.

checks.label: An item added later reacts to a click
